title: The Postcard of Maple Hollow
author: Juniper Blackwood
blurb: Edmund Underhill, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
